data.gender_notes: Namal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Namal is derived from the Arabic language and means 'Fish'. It is a unisex name with a calm, peaceful, and nature-inspired meaning. The name Namal carries the meaning “Fish” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Namal usually hope their child will grow to embody fish and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Namal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fish.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Namal total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: نمل
in_arabic.long_meaning: النمل هو اسم يدل على صغر الحجم، ويدل أيضًا على الدقة والتواضع، وقد ورد ذكر النمل في القرآن الكريم في سورة النمل، الآية 18، حيث قال تعالى: 'وَأَوْحَى رَبُّكَ إِلَى النَّحْلِ أَنِ اتَّخِذِي مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا وَمِنَ الشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ * ثُمَّ كُلِي مِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ فَاسْلُكِي سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا ۚ يَخْرُجُ مِن بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ فِيهِ شِفَاءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ ۨ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ'

in_urdu.name: نمل
in_urdu.long_meaning: نمل نام کی عربی اصلیت ہے، جو کہ 'نملة' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'چھوٹی چیونٹی'۔ یہ نام تواضع اور دقت کی علامت ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں اس نام کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں سورة النمل میں کیا گیا ہے، جہاں یہ داستان بیان کی گئی ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ نے چیونٹیوں کو بھی اپنی قدرت کا اظہار کیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नमल
in_hindi.long_meaning: नमल नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है 'छोटी चींटी'। यह नाम विनम्रता और सटीकता का प्रतीक है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, इस नाम का उल्लेख कुरआन में सूरा अन-नम्ल में किया गया है, जहां अल्लाह ने चींटियों को भी अपनी शक्ति का प्रदर्शन किया है।

in_english.name: Namal
in_english.long_meaning: The name Namal originates from Arabic, meaning 'small ant'. It symbolizes humility, precision, and modesty. In Islamic tradition, the name is mentioned in the Quran, Surah An-Naml, where Allah demonstrates His power even to ants, highlighting the importance of humility and the wonders of creation.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name Namal holds a unique meaning as it is derived from nature - a fish. Fish is considered a symbol of life, prosperity, and abundance in Islamic beliefs. In various Hadiths (sayings of the Prophet Muhammad), fish is mentioned as a form of sustenance from Allah. Therefore, the name Namal can be seen as a reminder of the blessings and provisions from Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Namal holds a deeper spiritual significance in Islam as it refers to the concept of inshallah - "if Allah wills it." The word 'namal' in one of its Arabic meanings also refers to keeping something safe or guarded. So, the name Namal can be interpreted as "Allah will keep us safe and provide us with the blessings of sustenance." It serves as a reminder to have faith and trust in Allah, and all our affairs are ultimately in His hands.
